text:
Joel Kiviranta is back in Dallas after his years in Colorado, playing about 12 minutes a night in the bottom six. Yardbarker noted his return to the lineup for the rematch in Vegas on Nov 19, which the Stars won 4-3.

He has two goals and three points in 16 games, right about where his chances say he should be. The Stars are close to even in expected goals with him on at five on five, a little worse than without him.

Evolving-Hockey had his value last season coming mostly from the penalty kill, where he took chances away at the 90th percentile, with the caveat that he played with very strong teammates in Colorado. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him exiting the zone with possession 60% of the time, a useful skill on a checking line.

He's an undrafted Finn who has made a career out of being dependable, and he played for Finland at the 2026 Olympics. What to watch: whether he holds the spot through Dallas's next healthy return. Dallas has won six of his last ten games.
